content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm new to using [product_name] modules. I'm trying to connect my [product_name] to my laptop via Ethernet cable. My PC IP is 192.168.0.2, the [product_name] IP is 192.168.0.5, the subnet mask is 255.255.255.0, and the gateway is 0.0.0.0. However, I cannot connect to the [product_name]; the connect button in the online tab is disabled. When I ping the device using cmd, data packets are sent. I'm currently running the demo version of [product_name] software ([version_no]). Thank you.
With the demo version, connecting to a [product_name] is not possible. You will need to use the full version for direct connection.

Hello [user_name], the demo version functions only for simulation; you cannot perform download, upload, or program transfer to an actual [product_name] device unless you purchase the full [product_name] software.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face difficulties connecting the software to the hardware module with the demo version of [product_name] software. While the connect button is disabled, users can still ping the device at the network level, leading to confusion. The main issue is inadequate communication of demo limitations in the interface, causing uncertainty about what is possible.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to use the demo version of [product_name] software for download and program transfer to their hardware module.
